from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-6fc09535.py'
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    divider_colors = {grid[i][0] for i in rows} | {grid[0][j] for j in cols}
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in divider_colors)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ycuts = [-1] + rows + [h]
    xcuts = [-1] + cols + [w]
    yparts = [(ycuts[k] + 1, ycuts[k + 1]) for k in range(len(ycuts) - 1)]
    xparts = [(xcuts[k] + 1, xcuts[k + 1]) for k in range(len(xcuts) - 1)]
    panels = []
    for y0, y1 in yparts:
        for x0, x1 in xparts:
            if y0 < y1 and x0 < x1:
                panels.append((y0, y1, x0, x1))
    source_panel = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(grid[i][j] != background for i in range(p[0], p[1]) for j in range(p[2], p[3])))
    sy0, sy1, sx0, sx1 = source_panel
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for y0, y1, x0, x1 in panels:
        if (y1 - y0, x1 - x0) != (sy1 - sy0, sx1 - sx0):
            continue
        for i in range(y1 - y0):
            for j in range(x1 - x0):
                out[y0 + i][x0 + j] = grid[sy0 + i][sx0 + j]
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path)
